Six kids in your nani's photo, maybe one in yours. India population decline isn't decades away, it has quietly begun.
Japan already shuts about 450 schools a year, some the day their last two students graduate. India's fertility rate is now 1.9, below the 2.1 a country needs to stay the same size.
Full story on YouTube, with the city where it has already started.
How many brothers and sisters did your nani have? Tell me in the comments.

short:
India population could fall by 20 crore by 2100. No war, no disaster, just a fertility rate below 2.
We're at 1.9, under the 2.1 needed to stay the same size, yet still growing, like a long train with the brakes on. Population decline starts after the peak in the early 2060s, says the UN.
Full story on YouTube, numbers and all.
One child, two, or none? Tell me in the comments.
